title: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 and IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 stores…
description: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator versions 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 and IBM Sterling File Gateway versions 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 store potentially sensitive information in log files. These log files could be accessed by a local user with elevated privileges, potentially exposing confidential data. The vulnerability does not allow remote exploitation and does not impact integrity or availability.
